2607.29238.title: Small Is Enough: Per-User Style Rewriting of AI-Edited Text via LoRA Adapters
2607.29238.paper_summary: InMyStyle is a privacy first, single user system that adapts small language models to rewrite AI-edited text towards an individual user's writing style without an instruction prompt at inference. Given a user's documents, it uses multiple local helper LLMs to construct paired training examples and fine tunes LoRA adapters on base models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters. Length aware generation budgets and automatic chunking support inputs of different lengths. On 219 evaluation pairs from a scientific-paper corpus, the automatic composite score plateaus at 0.69 [scale 0-1] across all model sizes under both greedy and sampled decoding. This observed plateau suggests that small models are sufficient for the measured rewriting task, with model size determining trade-offs rather than a stable quality ranking. As a secondary evaluation, 400 ratings from five LLM judges give InMyStyle outputs a mean perceived AI-ness score over 20% lower than their helper-AI generated inputs, while mean perceived AI-ness scores decrease with model size within InMyStyle.
2607.29238.paper_summary_zh: InMyStyle 是一個以隱私為首要考量的單用戶系統，能夠調整小型語言模型，以在推理過程中不需要指令提示的情況下，將 AI 編輯的文本改寫為個別用戶的寫作風格。<lb/>根據用戶的文件，它使用多個本地輔助 LLM 來構建配對訓練範例，並在基礎模型上微調 LoRA 適配器，這些模型的參數範圍從 0.5B 到 7B。<lb/>考慮到長度的生成預算和自動分塊功能，支持不同長度的輸入。<lb/>在來自科學論文語料庫的 219 個評估對中，自動綜合得分在所有模型大小下的貪婪和抽樣解碼中均穩定在 0.69 [範圍 0-1]。<lb/>這一觀察到的平臺表明，小型模型對於測量的改寫任務是足夠的，模型大小決定了權衡，而不是穩定的質量排名。<lb/>作為次要評估，來自五位 LLM 評審的 400 條評分顯示，InMyStyle 的輸出平均感知 AI 程度分數比其輔助 AI 生成的輸入低 20% 以上，而在 InMyStyle 中，平均感知 AI 程度分數隨著模型大小的增加而減少。
